Summary: Instructions

  • You start with an endowment of {{ Constants.endowment }}.
  • You have a 1/3 chance of loosing your endowment.
  • You have to decide how much to transfer to the other person, in case he/she is loosing his/her endowment.
  • You can transfer between 0 and {{ Constants.endowment }}.
  • The other person takes the same decision.
  • In case no one loses their endowment, you receive the full bonus of {{ Constants.endowment }}.
